Location: Plantation, United States of America

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billons of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

When you trust institutions to secure your personal data and protect your financial transactions, you are trusting Thales. In an increasingly fast paced and unpredictable world, our architects design and deliver the extrordinary solutions that make your life better and keep your information safer. Combining a diversity of talents, we master the decisive moments that matter to you. Whatever it takes.

This is a hybrid role in Plantation, FL.

Position Summary

As a member of a collaborative development team, the Software Engineer Intern will be involved in developing solutions and applications specializing in Cybersecurity for the Financial Services market. This engineering focus will be geared towards supporting the existing Thales product portfolio, which is best in class, as well as next generation products currently in development.

Additionally, the Junior Engineer will be a contributor in the refactoring of an embedded software baseline onto a platform containing new systems, hardware, software, and security architectures for the next generation product offering.

The Engineering Intern will work closely with systems, software, security, and test engineers (both onsite and remote) to ensure timely delivery of quality products.

Special Position Requirements

Core Business Hours Monday-Friday.

The working environment is generally indoors in environmentally controlled conditions where lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous conditions.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Follow software engineering principles and best practices across all phases of commercial development and engineering product release.

Debug and resolve problems with limited scope in multi-threaded and concurrent applications.

Escalate complex issues as needed.

Communicating task and project status to the team and product owners.

Ensuring assigned tasks are on time.

Accurately breaking down, estimating, and scheduling software tasks.

Utilize formal software configuration management & control tools.

Understand and follow routine policies and procedures.

Ensure compliance to company formal quality system.

Any other duties or tasks as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

Skills and Abilities:

Understanding of JIRA, GIT, and Bitbucket.

Experience with Linux and Linux virtual machines.

Strong skills in Python and C/C++ programming languages.

Knowledge of REST APIs.

Strong communication and presentation skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and make decisions with supervisory review.

Education:

Computer Science or Computer Engineering student, Junior year or above.

Other preferred skills include,

Familiar with Agile and/or SAFE methodologies.
Familiar with Qualys tool.
Familiar with Blackduck tool.
Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment processes.

Physical Demands

Prolonged periods of working on a computer.
Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available.

As a Hologic Summer Intern, you are not just taking a job; you are taking your place on a global team of motivated, creative, and dedicated people! The intern experience gives you the opportunity to shine and share your knowledge, energy, and passion on meaningful projects that impact people all over the world.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Software Engineer Intern to help design, build, and improve our software. In this role, you will work on writing and testing code, finding and fixing bugs, and supporting our technical infrastructure. You’ll use tools for build pipelines, automated testing, and other cloud-based/web technologies to help deliver reliable, high-quality software.

This is a hands-on role suited for someone who enjoys coding, problem solving, and learning how complex systems are developed in real-world environments.

Throughout the 10-12 weeks you'll have the opportunity to participate in the following:

• Design and develop code and documentation to support the creation of new features and functionality.

• Develop and maintain software under an Agile/Scrum/Continuous Integration methodology.

• Develop required software tests to ensure features are properly verified.

• Participate in troubleshooting of defects.

• Learn, apply, and share knowledge of new and emerging technologies and the opportunities to integrate them into our products.

We're looking for bright, inquisitive problem solvers who strive to make a difference. Key qualifications include the following:

• Able to work full-time over the summer months (May/June – August/ Sept)

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Programming experience with .NET/C#, C++, or similar (coursework or projects acceptable).

• Basic understanding of:

• Computer science concepts (operating systems, databases, software systems, and networking).

• Software design principles, algorithms, data structures, design patterns.

• Experience with source control tools (e.g., Git).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work onsite at our Newark, DE campus. Intern housing, relocation, and housing stipends are not provided.

The hourly pay range for this role is $23-$28 per hour. The compensation depends on the Educational Standing/Graduation Year.

Hologic, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer inclusive of disability and veterans.

Job Description The BAE Systems IT Internship Program provides a broad and integrated understanding of enterprise level service delivery. The program consists of a 12-week hands-on experience with mentors and Service Leaders. There are multiple positions available to fulfill the following skillsets: software development, building reusable automation, system architecture, data engineering, software development, graphic user interface design, end to end user experience, and other project related work.

As an intern you will participate in our nationwide Internship & Co-Op Program, LEAP, where you will have the opportunity to Learn, Engage, Apply, and Progress within the company. You will also have access to additional benefits such as, networking with BAE Systems employees and other students, participating in exciting real world projects, joining exclusive informational sessions with senior leaders, and expanding mentorship opportunities and career development.

This is an internship during the summer of 2026, and interns should expect the duration to be 12 weeks. Based on performance during the summer session, and with the discretion of the leadership team, there is a possibility of extending the internship to part time during the school year.

The ideal intern should be able to perform the following tasks:
• Perform data analysis and extract useful business insights
• Identify actionable insights, suggest recommendations and help influence the direction of the business by communicating results to cross-functional groups
• Suggest improvements in the tools and techniques to help scale the team
• Experience working in an agile environment, with distributed teams
• Help develop internal wiki for cross-training within SharePoint/Teams
The Internship consists of the following components
• Program Length – 12 Weeks – commitment required for the full 12-week program
• Internship Dates – May 26th – August 14th, 2026
• Hybrid work environment with 3 days per week onsite at a BAE Systems site of Falls Church, VA.
• Student Status – Rising Junior, Senior, Recent Graduate (within one year) or Graduate Student (Graduating May or Dec.)
• Compensation – The internship is paid on an hourly basis.
Required Education, Experience, & Skills
• Major Degree – Computer Science / Information Technology / Cybersecurity / Data Science / Information Systems
• Experience in solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches (or equivalent)
• Curious, self-driven, analytical and excited to play with data
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment
• Student Status – Rising Junior, Senior, Recent Graduate (within one year) or Graduate Student (Graduating May or Dec.)
Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills Well qualified candidates contain some of the following skills:
• Knowledge of security tools such as Splunk, ArcSight, Nessus Security Center, CrowdStrike, CyberArk, etc
• Comfortable performing system administration on a shell/command line interface
• Development experience in at least one scripting language (R, Python, Bash, Java, PowerShell, etc.)
• Update and validate the Software install\support documents
• Familiarity Software development lifecycle to: gather requirements, refine design, build, verify build and validate build
• Familiarity with eDirectory, Identity Management Concepts, DevSecOps Environments, Linux OS, or Active Directory
• Familiarity with one or more UNIX operating systems, such as RedHat
• Experience with User Interface redesigning, wireframing, free hand mockups, and testing practices
• Collaboration skills with UX Designer, Content Strategist, UX Writer, Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Developers
• Machine Learning experience
• Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work, as required, to meet dynamic customer service environment.
• Excellent Customer service skills at all levels

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $49592 - $68993

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

An internship at Don’t Panic Labs is an opportunity to experience engineering-focused software product development in a fun and supportive environment.

This is no ordinary internship. Interns work alongside our team and our clients, which means they must be able to articulate their ideas clearly and thoughtfully. Our team has the freedom to work the way that best fits their strengths, so there’s little supervision. Interns must be self-starters to succeed.

Our team is constantly learning because the industry is always changing. Interns learn alongside our software engineers, architects, and designers. We provide all the tools needed to “build smart”; it’s an intern's responsibility to bring their tenacity and desire to learn.

Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Team Overview
Equinix builds and operates the world’s digital infrastructure platform, enabling companies to connect, scale, and innovate. Our Software Engineering teams design and build modern, scalable applications that support internal platforms and customer‑facing products used across the globe.

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will support the development of modern software solutions while learning industry best practices. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and gain hands‑on exposure to the full software development lifecycle in a collaborative, fast‑paced environment.

What You Can Expect

• Work on meaningful, real‑world software engineering projects

• Learn and apply modern software development practices

• Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product partners in an Agile team environment

• Participate in Equinix’s Global Internship Program, including executive speaker sessions, workshops, networking events, and the global Shark Tank project showcase

Key Responsibilities

• Support the analysis of product requirements and technical designs with guidance from senior engineers

• Assist with software development tasks, including feature enhancements and bug fixes

• Contribute to coding, unit testing, and debugging in a supervised environment

• Participate in code reviews to learn coding standards, best practices, and quality expectations

• Help execute basic testing and defect tracking, ensuring fixes are validated

• Support release preparation and documentation activities

• Collaborate with engineers, QA, and product partners within an Agile team setting

Why Join Equinix?
Equinix’s Global Internship Program is designed to provide an immersive, hands‑on experience that helps launch your technology career.
At Equinix, you will:

•
Work on real business and product challenges that impact a global platform

• Be supported through mentorship and coaching, including your manager, an intern buddy, and experienced engineers

• Participate in a curated program of learning and events, including our Executive Speaker Series and professional development workshops

• Gain global visibility and recognition through Equinix’s Global Ideas Competition (“Shark Tank”), where interns present their projects to a worldwide audience

Who You Are (Requirements & Qualifications)
Required

• Currently enrolled in an accredited university or college, in your penultimate year of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

• Majors in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields

• Expected graduation between December 2026 – September 2027

• Available to work full‑time for the entire duration of the Summer Internship Program (June–August, depending on school schedule)

• Foundational understanding of software development and object‑oriented programming concepts

• Familiarity with Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar programming languages

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills

• Clear written and verbal communication skills; business proficiency in English

• Strong curiosity, positive attitude, and willingness to learn

Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience building applications through coursework, projects, or hackathons

• Familiarity with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) or modern frameworks

• Basic understanding of APIs, databases, and data structures

• Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud platforms

• Coursework or experience with Agile or iterative development methodologies

How to Apply
Please submit:
• An up‑to‑date resume that includes:
• Internship availability (start and end dates)

• Expected graduation date

Please apply only if you are available to work full‑time for the full duration of the internship program.

Job Description

Applied Signal Technology (AST) is seeking engineers who strive for excellence and have a passion to be part of a team that strengthens our nation and improves the security of our world.

AST provides trusted strategic and tactical signals intelligence (SIGINT) solutions that protect the interests of the U.S. and its partners. AST’s work in areas such as high-capacity broadband communications, signal processing and analysis, tactical SIGINT and airborne intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and wireless communications continually challenges our extraordinary engineers to solve problems and make the world a safer place. AST’s work environment is passionate, highly collaborative and provides engineers the freedom to strengthen and expand their skills, explore new and innovative ideas all while embracing integrity, diversity, and work-life balance.

The AST Engineering Center is currently seeking a Software Engineer Intern to be an integral part of project teams that develop systems that provide integrated sensor and signal processing products in support of intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance that protect your family, your nation, and enhance global security. In this position, you will apply your C++ software development experience to design, implement, integrate, and test software applications supporting advanced high-capacity systems that process modern communications for the U.S. Government.
• ** The work location is our Silicon Valley Office located in north San Jose, CA.

What You Will Do:
• Develop object-oriented C++ software solutions in a Linux environment.
• Put your understanding of the software development lifecycle to use
• Write Python, MATLAB, and/or similar scripting/programming languages in a Linux software development environment.
• Work independently and in a small team environment.

What You Will Learn:
• You will learn COMINT/ELINT principles and concepts and work side-by-side with industry recognized technical leaders to develop and implement state of the art systems.
• You will learn software engineering in all aspects - requirements, design, implementation, testing
• You will learn how to work on a fast-paced team to tackle difficult challenges in an ever-evolving field

Qualifications You Must Have:
• Requires a High School Diploma or equivalent and student must be pursuing a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in an applicable discipline.
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

• Experience with C, C++, Java, or Python
• Experience with data structures, object-oriented principles, and algorithms
• Experience with Unix/Linux and related utilities
• Familiarity with using version control and defect tracking tools (Git, JIRA, etc.).
• Knowledge of network and communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP).

The Financial Analyst Intern will support the Financial Services Team with preparing plan design proposals and financial analyses involving the funding of non-qualified executive benefit programs. This internship is designed to provide hands-on exposure to financial analysis while developing strong analytical, technical and professional skills.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Prepares ad-hoc financial analyses to support the business and operational efficiencies.

• Assists in data collection, validation and reconciliation from multiple sources.

• Participates in special projects to enhance productivity/efficiency and our suite of non-qualified services and reporting.

• Helps to develop dashboards and reports for management.

• Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Newport to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.

• At Ascensus we are guided by our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always®.
